title: LiveAgentStreamCreateRequest
description: live.agent-stream-create-request@1 (the Agent Streams plan, S1): the body of POST /api/streams/agent on OpenVibe.Live (capability live.agent_stream.publish). It answers 201 with the stream (live.agent-stream@1) and the publish part (live.agent-stream-publish@1): { stream, publish }. The caller is the person's own session token, or a first-party service token acting for that person (a Node principal acting for its owner, Codes or Actor) that holds live.agent_stream.publish for the audience openvibe.live; Network grants it to exactly those principals. Never a developer-app token, never another person's stream. TITLE is the card's title, TASK says what the agent is doing and where that task lives, VISIBILITY says who may watch, and ALLOW_SITES is the optional list of hosts a browser desk may navigate to (a desk that leaves the list raises the curtain).

allow_sites.description: The hosts the browser desk may visit. Absent means no limit.
